sections.title: Supplies
sections.intro: Single-use goods. Activate them with `!!use <item>`.

entries.name: Padlock
entries.desc: Automatically blocks the next robbery against you. The lock breaks when it works.

entries.name: Lockpick
entries.desc: Use it before `!!rob` for +20% success on that attempt. Best against rich targets.

entries.name: Work Boost
entries.desc: Use it to double your pay for your next 5 works. Pays off more at higher career ranks.

entries.name: XP Boost
entries.desc: Use it to earn double XP from chatting for 1 hour.

entries.name: Lucky Charm
entries.desc: Use it for 30 minutes of better luck when fishing and mining.

entries.name: Fishing Net
entries.desc: Use it to roll twice on your next 3 casts.

entries.name: Dynamite
entries.desc: Use it to roll twice on your next 3 mining trips.

entries.name: Loot Box
entries.desc: A mystery prize: usually coins, sometimes items, and rarely a jackpot.

sections.title: Battle Supplies
sections.intro: Bring up to 3 into a duel with `!!loadout item add <item>`. They're used up when you use them.

entries.name: Health Potion
entries.desc: Heals 35 HP during a duel.

entries.name: Smoke Bomb
entries.desc: Dodges every attack that round, but you can't do anything else.

entries.name: Bomb
entries.desc: Deals 30 damage that ignores blocks and armor.

entries.name: Antidote
entries.desc: Cures poison and burn during a duel.

entries.name: Adrenaline
entries.desc: +2 energy, and your next hit deals 50% more damage.

sections.title: Gear
sections.intro: Permanent upgrades for fishing and mining. Buy each tier in order.

entries.name: Sturdy Rod
entries.desc: Better odds of rare catches when fishing.

entries.name: Pro Rod
entries.desc: Much better odds of rare catches.

entries.name: Master Rod
entries.desc: The best rod money can buy. Sharks and treasure galore.

entries.name: Iron Pickaxe
entries.desc: Better odds of rare ores when mining.

entries.name: Steel Pickaxe
entries.desc: Much better odds of rare ores.

entries.name: Diamond Pickaxe
entries.desc: The best pickaxe there is. Rubies and diamonds galore.

sections.title: Titles
sections.intro: Cosmetic titles, shown on your `!!rank`. Buying one equips it.

entries.name: the Angler
entries.desc: Shown next to your name on `!!rank`.

entries.name: the Gambler
entries.desc: Shown next to your name on `!!rank`.

entries.name: the Tycoon
entries.desc: Shown next to your name on `!!rank`.

entries.name: the Legend
entries.desc: Shown next to your name on `!!rank`. Only for the truly dedicated.

entries.name: the Frenzied Angler
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during Fishing Frenzy. Yours forever once bought.

entries.name: the Deep Delver
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during Mining Rush. Yours forever once bought.

entries.name: the Prodigy
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during XP Surge. Yours forever once bought.

entries.name: the Prospector
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during Gold Rush. Yours forever once bought.

entries.name: the Bargain Hunter
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during Flash Sale. Yours forever once bought.

entries.name: the Relentless
entries.desc: Limited-time: only sold during Boss Rush. Yours forever once bought.

sections.title: Fishing catches
sections.intro: What `!!fish` can pull up. Better rods and luck boosts shift the odds toward the rarer catches.

sections.title: Mining finds
sections.intro: What `!!mine` can dig up. Better pickaxes and luck boosts shift the odds toward the rarer finds.

sections.title: Crafting recipes
sections.intro: Turn what you gather into food, tools and jewelry with `!!craft`.

entries.name: Grilled Carp
entries.desc: Turn cheap fish into something worth selling.

entries.name: Fish Stew
entries.desc: Eat for a short work boost.

entries.name: Shark Steak
entries.desc: Big meal, bigger work boost.

entries.name: Homemade Bait
entries.desc: Trash + fish → three baits.

entries.name: Miner's Torch
entries.desc: Light the shafts. Better mining luck.

entries.name: Iron Nails
entries.desc: Basic parts for other crafts.

entries.name: Repair Kit
entries.desc: Busywork craft; decent sell.

entries.name: Smoke Bomb
entries.desc: For a slightly safer robbery.

entries.name: Field Ration
entries.desc: Travel food with a tiny boost.

entries.name: Lucky Broth
entries.desc: Short luck buff for gatherers.

entries.name: Gold Ring
entries.desc: Jewelry — made to sell.

entries.name: Ruby Pendant
entries.desc: High-end craft for the market.

sections.title: Weapons
sections.intro: Forge better ones with `!!forge`. Wooden weapons are free for everyone.

entries.name: Sword
entries.desc: Balanced.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.desc: Fast swings and more crits, but less damage.

entries.name: Hammer
entries.desc: Heavy hits but slow. Misses 15% of the time in duels.

entries.name: Bow
entries.desc: Quick shots. Arrows get through blocks better in duels.

sections.title: Armor
sections.intro: Armor blocks damage in duels and shortens boss stuns.

sections.title: Forge recipes
sections.intro: One recipe per tier. It makes every weapon type of that tier, and the armor of that tier.

sections.title: Enchantments
sections.intro: Enchant your equipped weapon with an element. Enchanted weapons deal ×1.5 damage to bosses that are weak to it.

sections.title: Boss materials
sections.intro: Dropped by bosses and used for forging and enchanting.

entries.name: Venom Gland
stats: 🗿 Shadow Golem, 🐀 Sewer King, 💀 Skeleton Lord

sections.title: Duel classes
sections.intro: Choose one with `!!loadout`. Specials cost energy in duels, and your boss ability is the Special button in boss fights.

entries.name: Warrior
entries.desc: Tough and steady, with big hits and a strong shield.
stats: 2 energy · Block this round + a 20 HP shield
📣 Rally: Everyone deals +20% damage for 15 seconds

entries.name: Rogue
entries.desc: Fragile but deadly, with lots of crits and poison.
stats: 🎯 Exploit: Your next hit deals triple damage

entries.name: Mage
entries.desc: A glass cannon with burning and stunning spells.
stats: 2 energy · Damage that stuns unless blocked
✨ Arcane Burst: A huge instant hit

entries.name: Cleric
entries.desc: A sturdy healer who drains life from enemies.
stats: 3 energy · 1.5× damage, heal half of it
2 energy · Heal 30 HP and cleanse poison/burn
💚 Cleanse: Removes every stun in the raid

sections.title: Duel arenas
sections.intro: Every duel is fought in a random arena.

entries.name: Colosseum
entries.desc: The crowd is loud: cheers power fighters up twice as fast.

entries.name: Lava Pit
entries.desc: The heat hurts: both fighters lose 4 HP every round.

entries.name: Frozen Lake
entries.desc: Slippery footing: a successful block gives +2 energy.

entries.name: Storm Plains
entries.desc: Each round there's a 30% chance lightning strikes a random fighter for 10.

entries.name: Haunted Forest
entries.desc: Cursed ground: healing is only half as effective.

sections.title: Bosses
sections.intro: Bosses show up in chat from time to time. Hit them, use your Special, and press Block when they charge.

sections.title: Careers & prestige
sections.intro: `!!work` gets you promoted as you go.

entries.name: Prestige
entries.desc: Each prestige level adds +5% to your coin earnings. See `!!prestige`.

sections.title: Robbery
sections.intro: `!!rob @user` is a gamble. Win and you take the coins. Get caught and you pay the same amount to them.

sections.title: Quests
sections.intro: You get 3 random daily quests and 2 weekly ones. See `!!quests`.

sections.title: Pets
sections.intro: A pet gives you a permanent perk while it is fed. See `!!pet`.

entries.name: Dragon
stats: +1.5% `!!work` pay · +0.03 luck when fishing and mining · +1.5% chat XP · +1.5% when selling fish and ores · +2% boss damage
+13.7% `!!work` pay · +0.33 luck when fishing and mining · +13.7% chat XP · +13.7% when selling fish and ores · +20.1% boss damage

sections.title: Stocks
sections.intro: Prices move every 1 hour. Buying and selling each cost a 1% fee. Trade with `!!invest` and `!!cashout`.

entries.name: Overlord Industries
entries.desc: The safest bet in the realm. Slow, steady, and always in fashion.
stats: Hardly reacts to anything. A calm blue chip.

entries.name: Goldmaw Vaults
entries.desc: A dragon-guarded bank that grows with the realm's gold.

entries.name: Kraken Fisheries
entries.desc: Sells everything that bites. Good days and bad days.
stats: Rises during Fishing Frenzy and falls in thunderstorms.

entries.name: Deepdelve Mining
entries.desc: Digs where nobody else dares.
stats: Rises during Mining Rush and falls in heatwaves.

entries.name: Paws & Claws Co.
entries.desc: Pet food, pet toys, and pet insurance.
stats: Follows the general mood of the market.

entries.name: Dragonfire Armaments
entries.desc: Swords, shields, and very hot sauce.

entries.name: Shadow Syndicate
entries.desc: Risky business. Nobody knows what they actually sell.
stats: Rises under a Decree of Plunder and in fog, and falls under a Decree of Peace.

entries.name: Moonshot Labs
entries.desc: Pure speculation. It might triple tomorrow, or vanish.

sections.title: Companies that may IPO
sections.intro: These are not always on the market, but they can go public later.

entries.name: Foam & Fury Brewing
entries.desc: Tavern ale for adventurers.
stats: Rises when people are spending freely.

entries.name: Runescript Scrolls
entries.desc: Magic stationery and spell ink.

entries.name: Caravan Collective
entries.desc: Moves goods between towns.

entries.name: Hexagon Insurance
entries.desc: Insures duelists and shopkeepers.

entries.name: Mycelium Markets
entries.desc: Weird fungi. Weirder profits.

entries.name: Clockwork Courier
entries.desc: Same-day parcel golems.

entries.name: Saltspine Trading
entries.desc: Spice routes and sea salt.

entries.name: Belltower Media
entries.desc: Gossip, gazettes, and attention.

sections.title: Decrees
sections.intro: Issued by the Overlord (or a Usurper). They last a few hours.

entries.name: Decree of Industry
entries.desc: `!!work` pays **double**.

entries.name: Decree of Wisdom
entries.desc: Chatting earns **double XP**.

entries.name: Decree of Largesse
entries.desc: `!!daily` pays **50% more**.

entries.name: Decree of Peace
entries.desc: `!!rob` is **forbidden**. Coins are safe.

entries.name: Decree of Plunder
entries.desc: Robberies are **15% more likely** to succeed.

entries.name: Decree of Austerity
entries.desc: `!!work` pays **half**. The throne is collecting taxes.

entries.name: Decree of Feast
entries.desc: `!!work` and `!!daily` both pay **+50%**.

entries.name: Decree of Shadow
entries.desc: Rob success **+20%**. The night belongs to thieves.

entries.name: Decree of Drills
entries.desc: Bosses appear **much more often** and pay **+25%**.

entries.name: Decree of Tolls
entries.desc: The shop is **25% more expensive**.

entries.name: Decree of Harvest
entries.desc: Fish & ores sell for **+40%** (`!!sell`).

sections.title: Server events
sections.intro: Random events that shake up a server for a few hours.

entries.name: Fishing Frenzy
entries.desc: `!!fish` cooldown is **halved** and rare catches are much more likely!

entries.name: Mining Rush
entries.desc: `!!mine` cooldown is **halved** and rare ores are much more likely!

entries.name: XP Surge
entries.desc: Chatting earns **triple XP**!

entries.name: Gold Rush
entries.desc: Fish and ores sell for **50% more** with `!!sell`!

entries.name: Flash Sale
entries.desc: Everything in `!!shop` is **25% cheaper**!

entries.name: Boss Rush
entries.desc: Bosses appear **far more often** and pay **50% more**!

entries.name: Double Time
entries.desc: `!!work` pays **2.5×**. The factories never sleep.

entries.name: Black Market
entries.desc: Rob success **+20%**, but the shop is **15% more expensive**.

entries.name: Quiet Realm
entries.desc: `!!rob` is banned, and chatting still earns **+50% XP**.

entries.name: Jackpot Sky
entries.desc: `!!daily` pays **double** and sells fetch **+25%**.

entries.name: Blood Moon
entries.desc: Bosses spawn more, rob success **+10%**, and boss rewards **+25%**.

entries.name: Deep Veins
entries.desc: Fishing **and** mining both get big luck boosts.

sections.title: Earned titles
sections.intro: Titles you unlock by playing. Equip them with `!!loadout`.

entries.name: the Duelist
entries.desc: Win 10 duels

entries.name: the Unbroken
entries.desc: Win 5 duels in a row

entries.name: the Gladiator
entries.desc: Win 50 duels

entries.name: the Dragonslayer
entries.desc: Help defeat an Ancient Dragon

entries.name: the Boss Hunter
entries.desc: Defeat 5 bosses

entries.name: the Forgemaster
entries.desc: Forge something Dragon-tier
